title: Unit Event — Popping in My Heart! — Episode4 Get a Lost Girl to Smile!

meta.Episode: Episode4 — Get a Lost Girl to Smile!
meta.Event Outline: Emu takes part in a discussion with her brothers regarding future operations of the park. However, each idea she puts forth comes up against issues of feasibility, leaving her determined to educate herself. That's when she gets the news of an opportunity to visit Mr. Riley's park...

rows.Line: Riley Dream Park

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, there she is!
She's crouched down in the shade by that building!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You weren't kidding...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Thank goodness we found her.
But what's she doing behind one of the attractions like this?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She may've gotten lost while trying to find her parents and ended up here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <No wonder the other cast members couldn't find her.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Alright, let's put a smile on that face!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, wait!
You popping out of one of our phones like that's only going to scare her, Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yes, I agree.
We may want to just stay back and watch while they handle this, Miku.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That's too bad, but okay... We'll still be watching, so promise to make her smile, you guys☆>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed we shall! Looks like it's the world-famous Tsukasa Tenma's time to shine!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You've got this, Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you really sure he does...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ahem...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey...!! Girl!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My name is Tsukasa Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I am a star!
No... A future star of the world!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She seems suspicious.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh... Wait... I know!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Dance!! And!! Sing!!

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: WAAAAAAAAAAH!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wah?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no!! What happened?!
Why's she crying so much now?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You know perfectly well why...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yelling, “Dance!! And!! Sing!!” may not have been the best move.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wh-What do we do...?!
Oh, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sour face...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Spicy face!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yummy face☆

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
Smiley face!!

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: Hahahaha!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Look, she really smiled!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It just means that smiles know no borders.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Argh...!
My communication skills have a long way to go...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's what you think the problem is?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still, where could her family be?
She couldn't have come here all on her own, could she...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm wondering the same thing.
Why don't we ask her?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hi there. Are you lost? 
Do you know where your parents are?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What'd he just say...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think he just asked her if she's lost and where her parents are.

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: No... I can't find Mommy or Daddy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, she got separated from her parents and doesn't seem to know where they are.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
Hold on, Rui...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why didn't you just go and ask her that first?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because our great troupe leader seemed so eager to talk to her. I wasn't about to steal your thunder.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't believe that for a second!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But where do you think her mommy and daddy are...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hang on. Parks this big usually have a care center for lost children. Why don't we just go there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's see... Where could it be?
Is it on the map?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, isn't this a bulletin for it...?
It's telling the reader what to do if they ever get lost. There's even a map below to go with it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Great! Let's have a look!
Hmm... “Have you lost...?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Have you lost track of where your friends or family are? Let's be really brave and make our way to the Compass Center!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“This Compass Center is this way!
You can always try asking a grown-up if you're not sure where it is!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, thanks, Rui!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If only I'd been given more time...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, okay.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Still, this is very touching.
Mr. Riley's park even caters to the needs of children.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Getting lost is a frightening experience for a child, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But this little bulletin helps relieve some of that anxiety by giving them some encouragement and making it fun to reunite with their family.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This map even resembles a treasure map of sorts that a child can easily comprehend, unlike the regular park map.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... It's as if it's sending children on a quest to find the Compass Center.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow... That's so cool...!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I should jot this down too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, there's a cast member doing some cleaning over by the bulletin...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It'll probably be faster to ask them about what to do with her, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I would imagine that being much smoother...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What's wrong?
You're stuck to my leg like a little koala.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think she likes you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think so too. She still seems a bit frightened, so why don't we go to the center with her? I'm sure she'll be much happier if we do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed! We must put smiles above all else! Let's head over there together...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It looks like we can get to the Compass Center by passing between the “Blue World” and “The Little Kingdom” areas.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
